name: malformed-version-int53-negative-overflow
description: Anchor version is the JSON number -9007199254740992 (-2^53), one past the negative edge of the +/-(2^53-1) exact-integer bound spec/resolution.md's Structural Pre-Check step 1 gives every catalogue int field including version; the side is otherwise perfectly well-formed. The negative edge of this bound is otherwise unobservable: on range.end it's masked by step 3's end >= start check, so version is the only field where an implementation missing the lower bound (upper-bound-only) is caught, giving unsupported-version instead of malformed (WRIT-252 round 7 review)
